card.text: Explore Apophis in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Apophis is a near-Earth asteroid with a preliminary radar reconstruction. This view uses the published Model B at its original scale. Explore its original shape and radial heights. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery. The weak 2012–2013 radar data admit multiple shapes; the 2026 PDS release preserves the 2018 Model B rather than a new reconstruction. Apophis tumbles: the archived precession and rotation periods are 27.45 and 265.7 hours. This view uses a fixed illustrative frame, without propagating its tumbling attitude. No optical surface map is supplied.

shape.title: Radar shape model
shape.summary: Shape from radar observations. The gray grid marks missing optical imagery; lighting shows the model.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Distance above or below a reference sphere. Colors include the body's shape as well as local terrain.
